recommendations.rationale: At load levels starting from 500 users, CPU utilization reaches compute_cpu_pct_mean of 89.068% and compute_cpu_pct_p95 of 95.1%, coinciding with latency degradation (functions_p95_latency_ms reaching 570.0 ms). Increasing vcpu will alleviate CPU saturation.

overall_assessment: The performance bottleneck at 500 users and above is driven by severe CPU contention, with CPU utilization reaching 89.068% mean and 95.1% p95 at row 5 (500 users), spiking latency to 570.0 ms. RAM usage remains moderate under peak load (compute_ram_pct_p95 at 48.44% for row 5), so memory adjustments are unnecessary. Increasing vcpu from 2 to 4 addresses the latency issue without over-provisioning memory.
